note: Read back from the finalized PDF bytes at every write box, not from the finalizer's own report. On a flat document the write box is the measured blank the value sits on, the source's own text at those coordinates is subtracted so the form's printed caption is not reported as this build's ink, and measuredBlank travels with each write so a reviewer can check the placement against the paper.
